html:
Hello

Here is an image of the Pleiades (Messier 45) gathered over 4 evenings. Messier 45 is a reflection nebula caused by the reflection of the light of a cluster of young blue stars on a cloud of interstellar dust. In the constellation Taurus, Messier 45 is located 440 light-years away.



For this photo, here are the technical parameters
Date:  2010/11/06 - 2010/11/07- 2010/11/09- 2010/11/10
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 + f4.5 reducer - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the SkyVoyager software via Skyfi
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software
Temperature 0 to -5 deg celsius
Site: At home
36 exposures of 10 minutes for 360 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
Calibration/Registration/Integration and processing in PixInsight
